Union Suite · WIP prototype · display only

Task rows

Each scenario below is rendered twice at the same width: Current, the shipped .us-task row, and Proposed, a layout under discussion. Both use the real theme CSS and the real completion behaviour; the proposal adds a stylesheet scoped to its own frames, so nothing the current rows do is affected. Nothing here is in the theme.

The proposal changes shape with the width of the list, not the window, because the same page can hold a 600px homepage panel and a 1150px tasks page. It has two shapes: stacked below 480px, and title, note and meta beside a right-aligned due column above it. The width buttons are the sizes the list is actually used at.

Nothing is saved. Ticking a task runs the local completion sequence and no request is made. Reset rows restores anything completed.

Width

Supported author recipes, field definitions and iPart settings live in the usage guide (#task-completed-filter) and references/List-Templates.html. The proposed template and its scoped styles are in prototypes/wip/task-rows/; see that folder's README for the decisions behind them and what is still open.
